mapper.select: SELECT s.min_row_id AS row_id, s.accrual_id, s.shop_id, sh.name AS shop_name, s.product_name, s.first_accrual_date, s.max_accrual_date AS accrual_date, s.positive_amount_rub, s.negative_amount_rub, s.total_amount_rub, s.after_tax_amount_rub, s.total_amount_cny, s.record_count FROM ozon_accrual_summary s LEFT JOIN shop sh ON sh.id = s.shop_id

SELECT s.sales_product_key AS product_key, MAX(s.sales_product_name) AS product_name, MAX(s.sales_seller_sku) AS seller_sku, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(s.max_accrual_date, '%Y-%m'), '未知月份') AS report_month, SUM(s.sales_amount_rub) AS sales_amount_rub FROM ozon_accrual_summary s
GROUP BY s.sales_product_key, DATE_FORMAT(s.max_accrual_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY report_month, product_key

SELECT s.sales_product_key AS product_key, MAX(s.sales_product_name) AS product_name, MAX(s.sales_seller_sku) AS seller_sku, COUNT(*) AS sale_count, SUM(s.sales_amount_rub) AS sales_amount_rub FROM ozon_accrual_summary s
GROUP BY s.sales_product_key ORDER BY sale_count DESC, product_key

SELECT s.sales_min_row_id AS row_id, s.sales_product_key AS product_key, s.sales_product_name AS product_name, s.sales_seller_sku AS seller_sku, s.accrual_id, s.sale_date, s.sales_accrual_date AS accrual_date, s.sales_amount_rub FROM ozon_accrual_summary s
ORDER BY s.sale_date IS NULL, s.sale_date, s.sales_min_row_id
